title: M7: Lessons framework and first lessons
description: Intent: As the tutor and the student, I want lessons to be simple files in the repo that we add one by one, so that growing the curriculum is easy. Includes: lesson file format (markdown + starter project + expected-output checks), lesson list and navigation, progress per student, lesson starter loads into the IDE, first Python lesson and first C lesson. Excludes: automatic grading with hidden test suites, ranking. DoD: the student opens lesson 1, edits the starter, runs it, and sees a pass/fail check; adding a lesson requires only adding files.
right_now_summary: Lesson pages show instructions, load starter files, and check solutions with pass/fail results.
